# 3R Core
> Digital marketing agency in Lima, Peru specializing in online stores / e-commerce (Shopify, WooCommerce, Tiendanube), SEO positioning and Google Ads, plus web development, branding and social media management. Operating in Peru and the United States.

## About
3R Core is a full-service digital marketing agency based in La Molina, Lima, Peru. The agency combines three generations of experience, strategic vision, and technology to create personalized digital marketing strategies. Founded with the mission to help businesses grow their digital presence across Peru and the United States.

## Key Facts
- Headquarters: Alameda de la Paz 187, first floor, Urb. El Remanso, La Molina, Lima 15024, Peru
- Markets served: Peru, United States
- Languages: Spanish (primary), English
- Areas of expertise: branding, social media, SEO, Google Ads / SEM, web development, e-commerce
- Tech stack offered: Shopify, WooCommerce, custom Next.js, e-learning platforms
- Tax ID (RUC): 20609008217
- Track record: 1,000+ brands worked with, 3 countries, 5+ years (figures confirmed by the company, 2026-08-31)

## Services
- [Branding](https://3rcore.com/es/servicios/branding): Visual identity design, brand manuals, logos, and brand applications
- [Social Media Management](https://3rcore.com/es/servicios/socialmedia): Content strategy, post design, editorial grids, and social media management
- [Online Stores / Tiendas Virtuales](https://3rcore.com/es/tiendas-virtuales-lima): E-commerce stores on Shopify, WooCommerce or Tiendanube with local Peruvian payment gateways (Culqi, Niubiz, Izipay, Yape, Mercado Pago), ready to sell
- [Web Development](https://3rcore.com/es/servicios/web-development): Websites, e-commerce (Shopify/WooCommerce), landing pages, e-learning platforms
- [Google Ads / SEM](https://3rcore.com/es/servicios/google-ads): Google Ads campaigns, search intent segmentation, budget optimization
- [SEO Positioning](https://3rcore.com/es/posicionamiento-seo): Organic SEO, keyword strategy, content optimization, monthly reporting (S/1,800/month)
- [Meta Ads (Facebook & Instagram)](https://3rcore.com/es/servicios/meta-ads): Facebook and Instagram advertising campaigns, audience targeting, creative and retargeting for Peru.
- [TikTok Ads](https://3rcore.com/es/servicios/tiktok-ads): TikTok advertising campaigns, native creative and audience targeting to reach younger buyers.
- [Performance Marketing](https://3rcore.com/es/servicios/performance-marketing): ROI/ROAS-focused acquisition across paid channels, funnels and measurement.
- [Email Marketing](https://3rcore.com/es/servicios/email-marketing): email campaigns and automation, list segmentation and nurturing flows.
- [Marketing for clinics](https://3rcore.com/es/servicios/marketing-clinicas): digital marketing for clinics and medical practices to fill their appointment agenda.
- [Marketing for real estate](https://3rcore.com/es/servicios/marketing-inmobiliarias): lead generation for real estate developers and agencies.
- [Marketing for e-commerce](https://3rcore.com/es/servicios/marketing-ecommerce): performance marketing to scale online stores and sales.

## United States market
3R Core is a PERUVIAN agency serving U.S. clients remotely through its U.S. subsidiary. It does not present itself as a U.S. agency. In the United States it sells three services only: websites, SEO and online stores.
- [3R Core for U.S. brands](https://3rcore.com/en): English site
- [SEO agency](https://3rcore.com/en/seo-agency): $500/month, no mandatory contract

- [Hispanic marketing agency](https://3rcore.com/en/hispanic-marketing-agency): reaching Spanish-speaking customers in the U.S.
- [Ecommerce development](https://3rcore.com/en/ecommerce-development): Shopify and WooCommerce from $1,750
